unit.title: Recognize conversion rate ceiling is not set by page quality

Once you've taken the page as far as you can in regards to clarity, offer and proof, the next lever usually isn't another design test. unit.title: Understand the CAC argument for conversion rate

claim.text: The source explains that because conversion rate is the denominator in the CAC formula, doubling conversion rate halves CAC, which allows raising the CAC ceiling back up and could allow doubling or tripling volume; however, doubling conversion rate is described as an insane change almost never seen.
claim.quote: Because if you can double your conversion rate, because it's the denominator here, what that does is it will half your C. So, if you can take your conversion rate from 1 to 2%, it halves your CA. What does that allow? It allows you to spend a lot more on the platforms because you can allow your CAC ceiling to go back up to what it was originally, which will probably allow you to double or triple volume. So you could quite literally double to triple a business just on improving conversion rate. Now doubling conversion rate is an insane change and I've almost never seen anyone be able to effectively double their conversion rate.
